Fortunately, for the method used in this paper, the main property needed is that τij and σij are uniformly smooth assuming that the trajectories are smooth (and that they are away from the singularities).
If there are no external electromagnetic forces (or if the external electromagnetic forces are time independent), the classical model conserves energy, so that it does not have any hyperbolic orbits. On the other hand, in time dependent (e.g. periodic) external ﬁelds, many interesting models (e.g. ion traps, mirror magnet machines) have many hyperbolic orbits [Gho96, Kaj22].
